_README: Curated authorship corrections, keyed by wp_posts.ID. Hand-maintained — NOT derived,
so build.py reads it rather than regenerating it.
Why this file exists: wp_posts.post_author is wrong for a block of 2009 posts. A
WordPress 'delete user and reassign their posts' operation moved every post belonging
to user ID 4 onto the huertanix account (ID 25). The evidence:
- wp_users has a gap at ID 4 (1,2,3,5,6 exist), dated between ricko (2009-07-28)
and friedpope (2009-08-15).
- No row anywhere still carries post_author='4' — reassignment rewrote them all.
- wp_postmeta._edit_last='4' survives on posts 80, 112, 190, 196, 274. Deleting a
user rewrites post_author and drops wp_usermeta but leaves _edit_last alone.
- wp_comments identifies user 4 directly: comment 557 (2009-09-22), 735 (2009-12-24)
and 962 (2010-06-14), all comment_author 'Drea', drea@heatsynclabs.org,
site an-drea.tumblr.com.
- wp_user2role2object_rs gives user 4 the 'editor' role.
- huertanix registered 2009-11-13 04:30:28, yet is the stored author of nine posts
dated 2009-08-14 to 2009-10-30. His first genuine post, ID 203, is 74 minutes
after registration.
Because the reassignment target was huertanix and ID 4 is the only missing user, a
post stored under huertanix that predates his account was necessarily user 4's.
post_author in the database is left untouched: it is the primary record, its wrongness
documents the deletion, and build.py would overwrite any hand-edit on the next run.

80.evidence: Narrator is named in her own quoted phone call — "Um... Andrea. Rick says there's people in the lodge." — and writes "We had 30 attendees at the meeting, including Jeremy, Rick, Sean, and I." _edit_last=4. Predates the huertanix account by three months.

90.evidence: Dated 2009-08-19, three months before the huertanix account existed, so it was reassigned from user 4. No sign-off in the body.

106.evidence: Signed off in the body: "=] / drea".

162.evidence: Predates the huertanix account. Written by Sierra's co-organiser ("Please contact Sierra or myself"), and Drea commented on this post the next day as user 4 to add the venue address — the same address that opens her signed post 180.

187.evidence: Predates the huertanix account, and thanks "Dave" in the third person — huertanix is David Huerta.

202.evidence: Dated 2009-10-30, fourteen days before the huertanix account existed, so it was reassigned from user 4. No sign-off in the body.

239.evidence: Signed off in the body: "Drea". huertanix appears in this post's own comment thread as a separate reader three minutes after publication.
